messages:
Maria CSM: Heads up — Dovetail Labs (acct: DOV) showing a ~40% API call drop over last 14d and procurement says new vendor is in evaluation. Possible renewal risk. Can we triage? Details below.

Kevin AM: Ack. Do we have seat activity + billing trend?

Maria CSM: quick query:
```
api_calls_last_14d: 2,450  (was 4,200 14d prior)
active_seats: 18 -> 12
avg_latency_p90: 270ms -> 290ms
errors_5xx: 0.2% -> 0.8%
```
They also opened a ticket asking about "embedding parity with vendor X".

Devon SE: Noted. I'll check model mapping & embedding drift. Maria, can you share customer's eval criteria? also check if they hit rate limits or quota?

Maria CSM: @Devon they flagged cost and embedding quality. No rate limits on our side. Also had a support ticket from last week about "timeouts during long prompts" — @Lexi any link?

Lexi Support: Ticket #7621 — intermittent timeouts during long chat sessions on 2026-03-10. Root cause was autoscaler delay during heavy burst; we applied an infra tweak. Customer accepted workaround but asked for SLA language.

Omar Product: If they're asking about embedding parity, there's a gap: our sparse-token embedding for long docs is slightly different. We can run a side-by-side similarity eval quickly. @Devon I can spin up a quick compare job.

Devon SE: Thanks. I'll also extract 50 random customer prompts and run similarity vs vendor X — ETA EOD tomorrow.

Kevin AM: I'll coordinate an executive call with DOV procurement and propose a short pilot extension + usage credit if we see technical gaps. Can we have a one-pager on "what we fixed" + perf numbers before the call?

Maria CSM: Action items:
- Devon: similarity eval + sample prompts (due 2026-03-19)
- Omar: run side-by-side embeddings job (due 2026-03-18)
- Lexi: paste ticket link and incident summary in thread (ASAP)
- Kevin: schedule procurement/exec call (target 2026-03-20)
- Maria: prepare usage trend + one-pager (ASAP)

Devon SE: Will post eval results and brief in-thread.

Lexi Support: Ticket link: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/7621 — summary posted.

Maria CSM: Thanks team :pray: I'll set up the call and loop in legal if we need a short-term amendment. Let's re-check in 48h.

ops-bot: Reminder set for 48h.
